$Comment: The occasional extras a trim order turns up, beside the wage and the tools. Two rolls, both
bonuses: neither is anybody's reason for filling the order, and a run that pays neither is an
ordinary run rather than a bad one.
LUCK ACTS ON THE ODDS HERE, not on the size of what lands, and that is the difference between
this file and the wage. A wage is a quantity, so luck decides how big it is there. A find is a
yes or a no, so luck decides how often it happens here. Keep that split when you author a table
of your own: luck acting on both axes inside one table pays the same investment twice.
A Chance is a percentage from zero to one hundred. Base is what the roll reads at no luck at
all, each Factors entry adds its Weight per whole point of the channel it names, and Clamp.Max
is the ceiling however much luck is stacked on top. MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING stores WHOLE percent
points, so a fully claimed Woodcutting tree reads near a hundred and a geared worker past a
hundred and sixty; the Weights below are sized against that scale. Never swap the channel for
the mmoskilltree:station_luck aggregate, which returns a FRACTION and would make the term vanish.
Rolls evaluate INDEPENDENTLY, so both of these can land on the same claim.
THE DEEP FIND also carries a level Condition, which is a hard gate rather than a scaling term:
below that level the roll never fires at all, however lucky the worker is. Either they are deep
enough into the trade to shake concentrated essence out of a log or they are not. Move the Min
to change when the mill starts giving up the good stuff.
Each carries a Cue, the celebration id a roll may author beside its Grants; it fires only when
the grants beside it genuinely paid out. Rare_Find is the everyday chime the MMO jar ships as a
toast; the concentrated essence names the Sawmill's own deep-find cue so a rare find sounds like
a rare cycle. Author a new Cue value plus a Server/ZiggfreedCommon/FeedbackMoments file of that
name for a celebration of your own.
Name: Mmo_Sawmill_Trim_Finds

Rolls.$Comment: Concentrated essence, for a worker deep enough into the trade to find it at all, and likelier the more luck they have put into the tree.
A personal Woodcutting boost token, on a gentler luck curve than the deep find and a lower ceiling, so it stays a pleasant surprise rather than a supply line.
